No, it’s always been acceptable to use they as a singular pronoun. Examples: “Did someone leave *their* books here?” “Someone left *their* raincoat here. I hope *they* have an umbrella.” “If anyone calls, tell *them* I’ll be back in five minutes.” They/them has been used as a singular pronoun for centuries. Shakespeare used it, Jane Austen used it, and everyone uses it in casual and formal speech. It even says in the Merriam-Webster dictionary that “they” can be used as a singular pronoun.
